tagline: Africa's Stories for the World's Children

episodes.title: Jam Day Under the Baobab
episodes.theme: Lebo and Jabu turn a berry-jam mess into a picnic under a baobab.

episodes.title: Penguins at the Cape
episodes.theme: A windy seaside day introduces African penguins and ocean care.

episodes.title: Stars Over the Kalahari
episodes.theme: A night journey becomes a game of stars, sounds and desert survival.

episodes.title: The Great Zimbabwe Builders
episodes.theme: Lebo and Jabu discover how planning, teamwork and stonework can shape history.

episodes.title: Drums & Colours in Accra
episodes.theme: A city celebration introduces rhythm, patterns and respectful cultural curiosity.

episodes.title: The Nile's Long Journey
episodes.theme: A map adventure follows part of the Nile and asks where rivers come from and where they go.

episodes.title: Rain on the Serengeti
episodes.theme: Jabu worries about a storm until the friends learn why seasonal rain matters.

episodes.title: Market Shapes in Marrakesh
episodes.theme: A lively market scavenger hunt turns doors, tiles and baskets into a shapes lesson.

episodes.title: Island Wonders of Madagascar
episodes.theme: A lemur-led trail explores what makes island ecosystems special.

episodes.title: Our Big Africa Map
episodes.theme: Friends from the season help Lebo and Jabu build a giant map of memories.
